title: AlloyDB Autoscaling Now Supports Connection Count Policies
summary: AlloyDB introduces a new `connectionsCount` policy for autoscaling, allowing you to scale instances based on the target number of active connections. This provides finer-grained control over resource allocation.
details: The `Policy` schema now includes an optional `connectionsCount` field, which references the newly added `ConnectionsCount` schema. This new policy allows you to specify a `targetCount` (an optional `int64` formatted string) for the desired number of connections. By leveraging this, developers can configure their AlloyDB instances to automatically scale based on connection load, optimizing performance and cost.
